# Hand-history fixtures

Drop exported GGPoker hand histories here as `.txt` files, e.g.:

- `cash-nl10-01.txt`
- `rush-and-cash-01.txt`
- `pko-01.txt`

The parser tests run against these.

- `cash-nl25-01.txt`: a GG export of 19 hands at NL25 6-max (table NLHRed23, 2026-10-11),
  originally `GG20261011-1418 - NLHRed23 - 0.1 - 0.25 - 6max.txt`.

Still wanted: a Rush & Cash export and a PKO export (with bounties).
